title: MCP Server Security: Vet It Before You Install
description:
That MCP server runs with your permissions, so check it before you install. 🔍

✅ Why MCP servers deserve a security check
✅ Grep your config for latest tags and curl or shell calls
✅ Pin the version, read it, then install

comment: Pin the version or skip the server: which would you pick? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: npx with latest can pull new code every run, so a pinned version means you only trust code you checked.
